-- worker pulls one job atomically
WITH next_job AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM {{queue_table}}
  WHERE status = 'pending'
  ORDER BY created_at
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE {{queue_table}} q
SET status = 'running', started_at = NOW()
FROM next_job
WHERE q.id = next_job.id
RETURNING q.*;
summary_zh: 用 SKIP LOCKED 做 postgres job queue
